xychart
title "Different Colors in xyChart"
x-axis "categoriesX" ["Category 1", "Category 2", "Category 3", "Category 4"]
y-axis "valuesY" 0 --> 50
%% Black line
line [10,20,30,40]
%% Blue bar
bar [20,30,25,35]
%% Green bar
bar [15,25,20,30]
%% Red line
line [5,15,25,35]
